artworks.title: Oh Patrie!!!
artworks.description: The image depicts a man walking with his arms crossed in front of his chest. He has a stern expression, a prominent jawline, and wears glasses, a hat, a long coat, and boots. Snow is falling heavily around him. The background shows a wintry urban scene with a building and snowy ground.

artworks.title: Tiens v'la peut-etre une pratique
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in an indoor setting. The main figure on the left is standing and wearing a long robe and a square cap, possibly a lawyer or academic. The person has a side profile view, a prominent nose, stern expression, and gray hair under the cap. They are holding an item under one arm. The second figure is being escorted by a third person in a uniform with a tall hat, guiding them by the arm. The background shows a partial wall and column.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Wisdom
artworks.medium: brown ink with gray and brown wash and white heightening over black chalk, squared for transfer in black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures surrounded by clouds. The image shows various figures interacting in graceful poses, some with wings and flowing clothing. The scene appears to depict a lively, otherworldly assembly with the figures engaging with each other. The clouds are depicted with soft, swirling lines, creating a sense of depth and ethereal atmosphere. Light and shadow within the clouds add dimensionality, while delicate inked outlines define the whimsical and serene nature of the illustration.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a woodland scene with trees, hills, lions, and a running watercourse. The detailed etching shows a dramatic sky with swirling clouds and fine lines capturing light and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and gray. Brushwork in the sky contrasts with bold strokes defining the landscape.

artworks.title: Two Monks with a Prostrate Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and added gray wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. One figure stands in the center, pointing with one hand. Another figure sits to the right, and a third figure lies on the ground to the left. The background is sketchy.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Isaac
artworks.medium: red chalk with white heightening on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two male figures in an intense interaction. The composition is in a monochrome reddish-brown medium, likely red chalk. One figure is bent forward with a determined expression, while the other is kneeling with his arms restrained behind him. The emphasis is on the anatomy and interaction of the two forms, in the style of Michelangelo.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical mythological scene set within rococo ornamentation. The scene depicts various figures in an outdoor setting surrounded by trees and cliffs. In the center, a group of elegantly dressed figures are engaged in conversation. Above them, ethereal figures float on clouds, one holding a symbol or crest. The foreground features objects resembling fruits or offerings. The scene is enclosed within an ornate rococo border.

artworks.title: Vierge à l'enfant sculptée par Geoffroy-Dechaume, chantier de la cathédrale Notre-Dame, Paris (Madonna and Child, sculpted by Geoffroy-Dechaume, Notre-Dame Cathedral, Paris)
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a woman holding an infant in her left arm. The woman wears a crown and flowing robes, holding a scroll in her right hand. The child appears wrapped in cloth. The material seems to be stone or marble, with a light color that accentuates the craftsmanship details. The sculpture is placed outdoors, surrounded by wood and stones. Stone figures are partially visible in the background. Both figures have calm expressions, conveying a timeless and stable presence.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: East Door of the Maha-thugea-yan-tee Pagoda
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a temple facade. There is a large entrance at the center, adorned with intricate carvings and relief patterns. Steps lead up to arched doorways, flanked by statues of mythical creatures. The temple extends laterally with multiple smaller arches and decorative spires. The stone surface appears weathered. The temple is set against a clear sky.

artworks.title: Personification of Rome
artworks.artist: Hieronymus Hopfer after Giovanni Battista Palumba
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated against an ornately decorated architectural arch, surrounded by a tree. The person has a bent leg and reaches out to hold a small winged figure standing on their hand, which holds a laurel wreath. The person has sharp facial features, voluminous hair cascading from underneath a detailed helmet, and is dressed in a draped garment with exposed shoulder and chest, complemented by armor on their lower legs and sandals. The setting includes shields, a sword, and various decorative objects with patterns and faces. The background shows an arched niche with a pattern and landscape elements such as grass.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The engraving depicts the head-and-shoulders portrait of a woman looking upwards and to her right. She has large eyes, softly curved lips, and styled hair with a hairpiece or bow. She wears draped clothing, an earring, and a necklace with a pendant. The background features textured lines forming an oval frame around her, accentuating her face.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Large Rainbow
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a lower angle viewpoint. The horizon is positioned at the upper third of the image with a strip of lighter sky contrasting with dark clouds. The horizon is dotted with trees and farm structures. The brushstroke technique is intricate with fine lines creating texture. The color palette consists of black, gray, and white. Two figures are walking on a path through a wooded area, and haystacks and a horse-drawn cart are visible in the distance. Depth is achieved through the transition from dark foliage to lighter fields. An element in the sky suggests a rainbow or beam of light.

artworks.title: Landscape with Large Roman Ruins
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with various natural and architectural elements. In the foreground, there are people by a stream, with one figure crouched and others standing around. Further back, there is a shepherd with sheep in a pasture and a fenced enclosure with a small round-roofed building. In the background, there are mountains under a sky filled with dramatic clouds. To the left of center, there are ruins of a large, classical structure with greenery growing over the walls. The image is rendered in fine lines, creating intricate textures, and is monochromatic in shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Sailing Boats in a Tempest
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Andries van Eertvelt
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large ship navigating rough seas. The horizon is low, more ships can be seen in the background. The etching style features detailed lines depicting the movement of the sea and sky. The clouds are dense and textured, adding to the stormy atmosphere. The color scheme is limited to black, white, and shades of gray, creating a stark contrast. Waves, the ship, and storm clouds are prominent in the composition.

artworks.title: The Virgin
artworks.artist: Gabriel Ehinger after Johann Heinrich Schönfeld
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body in a three-quarter view, slightly turned to the left. They have long hair that falls over their shoulders, partially covered by a draped garment. The person is wearing a long-sleeved garment with folds apparent around the chest and arm areas, and one hand is delicately placed on their chest while the other hand rests lower, grasping a part of the garment. The background features a textured, diagonal hatching pattern.

artworks.title: Christ the Savior
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man with his left arm raised and fingers extended upwards. He has a beard, wavy hair reaching his shoulders, and a calm expression on his face. He is dressed in flowing robes with intricate drapery. The background consists of numerous fine lines, creating an illusion of depth or light emanating from an unknown source to the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Lust
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 29.2 x 26.1 cm (11 1/2 x 10 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene featuring various animals and celestial or mythical figures gathered around a central platform. The scene is detailed, showcasing creatures like a boar, deer, birds, and a winged creature. Atop the platform, a female figure holds a torch high, surrounded by other figures including one with wings and a bow. The background includes a landscape under a cloudy sky. The work is intricately engraved with a high level of detail and complexity in its composition.

artworks.title: Triumphal Arch
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from an elevated perspective showing a classical arch with two figures conversing near it. The arch dominates the left side of the image, reaching towards the sky. The detailed etching style features fine lines and hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in brown tones, giving an antique look. Elements include two period-dressed figures on grass, an adorned arch with foliage, a clear sky with a few birds, and an inscription surrounded by rocks and trees.

artworks.title: Desert Monks
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques de Boissieu after Francisco de Zurbarán
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his arms crossed, looking straight ahead with a solemn expression. He is wearing a robe with a hood and a cord tied around his waist. Behind him, there is an older bearded person seated next to a clay jar, with a hand resting on their head and looking off to the side. The background features a large tree trunk and foliage, creating a serene outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a person's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is slightly hunched forward, with both hands visible at the bottom. One hand is holding a pen or stylus. The person's facial features are prominent, with sharp eyes and brow lines. Their expression conveys tension or intensity. The hair is unkempt with defined texture and volume. The person is wearing a collared shirt. The background is plain and light-toned, with abstract lines and scribbles on the left side. There are inscriptions in the top-left corner.

artworks.title: Saint Joseph and the Christ Child
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 24.9 x 18.5 cm (9 13/16 x 7 5/16 in.)
sheet (cut inside platemark): 25.4 x 18.5 cm (10 x 7 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features the upper bodies of two figures: an elderly man and a child. The man is sitting and shown in profile, facing the child who is seated on a ledge. The child appears to be supported by the man's shoulder and is reaching towards his face. The elderly man has detailed facial features, a long beard, and wavy hair falling around his face and neck. He is wearing loose robes and holds a rod in his right hand. The child is unclothed and placed on a surface resembling a decorative architectural piece, potentially a column with a scroll pattern. The background is plain, and the entire scene is enclosed within an oval frame.

artworks.title: The Crucified Christ in a Decorated Niche
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure with a crucifixion scene. The central figure is depicted on a cross, surrounded by an imposing shrine with classical details. The structure is adorned with carvings, including figures, scrolls, and foliage motifs. Two armored figures stand on the top of the structure, each holding a staff with a banner. At the base, there are mythical creatures and acanthus leaves decorating the niches. The overall composition is symmetrical, reminiscent of Renaissance engravings with a complex interplay of figures and decor.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Mill
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 24.8 x 32.5 cm (9 3/4 x 12 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a village situated in a rocky terrain. Various structures, trees, and cliffs fill the composition. The horizon is not clearly visible. The scene is depicted using detailed engraving strokes, creating texture in shades of gray and black on a light background. The foreground features boulders, a rocky ground, and mill structures with water wheels. Rustic buildings are seen arranged on different levels, supported by surrounding rock formations. A river winds through buildings in the middle ground, leading towards mountains in the background.

artworks.title: Wallfahrts Kirche in Thyrol
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with yellow and ochre tint stones on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a church on elevated terrain. The church has a pointed spire and Gothic architectural details. There is a stream or small waterfall in the foreground, with trees framing the scene. Behind the church are rolling hills and distant trees, under a sky with clouds. The illustration is in black and white, with fine, detailed brushstrokes.
